work.label: explore
work.definition: Leaves the person or agent knowing how something works or what the data says.

work.label: shape
work.definition: Leaves a settled question, spec or plan for what to build or how.

work.label: build
work.definition: Leaves the asked-for change made, including checking and committing it along the way.

work.label: debug
work.definition: Leaves something that was failing working again, or its cause found.

work.label: verify
work.definition: Leaves finished work checked, and does nothing else.

work.label: ship
work.definition: Leaves finished work committed, pushed or in a PR, and does nothing else.

shapes.gate: one or two short runs that end in a sign-off before the main work
shapes.cluster: several short runs in a row
shapes.chain: one piece of work cut into pieces by repeated stops
shapes.long run: one or two runs carrying most of the work
shapes.loop: short runs alternating with the same kind of stop
shapes.tail: short runs after the main work

patterns.label: batched interview
patterns.definition: All questions asked at once with defaults, answered in one stop.

patterns.label: spec sprawl
patterns.definition: A long discussion before the first long run that drifts into implementation detail.

patterns.label: plan gate
patterns.definition: A plan presented for sign-off before building.

patterns.label: checkpoint chain
patterns.definition: Approved work split into pieces by go-ahead stops.

patterns.label: scattered approvals
patterns.definition: A long piece of work cut by permission prompts throughout.

patterns.label: long run
patterns.definition: One or two runs that carry most of the work.

patterns.label: closed loop
patterns.definition: One run that builds, checks and ships its own work.

patterns.label: mid-build redirects
patterns.definition: Corrections that change the approach while building.

patterns.label: rework tail
patterns.definition: Corrections after a build, each followed by a short fix.

patterns.label: rework cluster
patterns.definition: A session of corrections to work done in another session, often on the same branch.

patterns.label: visual check loop
patterns.definition: Short alternating runs where the person reports what they see after each attempt.

patterns.label: ship tail
patterns.definition: Short runs at the end to run the suite, commit and open a PR.

patterns.label: follow-up
patterns.definition: A new, related ask after the work was done.
